title: Why You Blink More When You're Stressed
hook: Feeling stressed often makes you blink more.

narration.text: Feeling stressed often makes you blink more.
Your brain interprets heightened focus or anxiety as a threat.
It then triggers a protective reflex, increasing your blink rate.
This quickens tear distribution, keeping your eyes moist and sharp.
It is your body's way of optimising vision during intense moments.
Notice it next time you are under pressure or deeply concentrating.
Try it right now and tell me if it worked on you, like this if it surprised you, and subscribe for more insights into your mind.

description: Ever wondered why your blinking increases when you are nervous or deeply focused? It is your body's clever way of preparing your vision for heightened awareness. Discover the surprising mechanism behind this common reflex.
topic: Why you sometimes blink excessively when you are nervous or focused. Pay attention to your blinking when you feel intense emotions.
